text: Dr. Randy Campbell billed 8 claims after credential CRD_000103 was revoked on 2025-12-22, the first only 18 days after revocation. The volume is modest and the window short, which is why this scores low: clinics in this economy routinely keep a revoked doctor rostered for a few weeks while paperwork catches up, and 8 claims sits inside that honest range. What keeps it on the queue at all is the recency — the revocation is current, so the billing is happening now, not in an old tail. The likely explanation is administrative lag rather than laundering. Next step: a single confirmation from the rostering clinic that this doctor has been stood down closes it either way.
